verified.entry_point: The real HTTP API and public registry library of the pinned tree: POST /v1/agents/import (multipart archive), GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/download (hub pull, with the hub client's download method stubbed to hand back a locally built archive), POST /v1/agents/install (shared-profile document), POST /v1/agents/legacy-import (single-file manifest), POST /v1/chat/agents/{agent_id}/edit (real route, real schema, model provider replaced by a recorder), GET /v1/chat/agents/{agent_id}/files/content (workspace view), plus the public AgentRegistry API (import_agent, delete_agent, get_agent, list_agents). Nothing else is stubbed: the app is the project's FastAPI application with its dependency functions and real AgentRegistry/ConfigManager/CredentialManager wiring, driven through httpx's ASGI transport.

wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the sink has no roles, peers or directions; every profile intake and every agent-named read reaches the same filesystem operation
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: confinement is structural here (a fresh destination chosen by the service, and a canonical containment check); no external authority or secret can fail open
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: every fix is local to one surface; the only shared helper added is a pure id predicate and no neighbouring API's stated behaviour depends on it
